svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "Tobacco mosaic virus: a rod-shaped plant virus."], [1, "Its genome is one molecule of single-stranded RNA."], [3.5, "Identical protein subunits assemble in a helix around the RNA."], [8, "The finished rod: a helical capsid, hollow in the middle, with no envelope."]]
svg.title: Tobacco mosaic virus structure
svg.desc: Tobacco mosaic virus: a rod-shaped helical capsid of identical protein subunits wound around single-stranded RNA, with a hollow central channel.
svg.text: Helical virus; the first virus to be discovered (1892–1898).

g.data-info: One (+) RNA molecule of about 6400 nucleotides, wound in a helix between the protein subunits.
About 2130 identical protein subunits arranged in a helix: a helical capsid.
The rod is hollow: a channel about 4 nm wide runs down the middle.
About 300 nm long and 18 nm wide. No envelope.

g.text: ≈ 300 nm long × 18 nm wide (outside view of the rod)
